# uptimekuma_notification_signal (Resource)

Signal notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_signal" "example" {
  name       = "Signal Notifications"
  url        = "http://signal.example.com:8080"
  number     = "+1234567890"
  recipients = "+9876543210,+1111111111"
  is_default = false
}

resource "uptimekuma_notification_signal" "with_single_recipient" {
  name       = "Signal Single Recipient"
  url        = "http://signal.example.com:8080"
  number     = "+1234567890"
  recipients = "+9876543210"
  is_default = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Notification name
- `number` (String) Signal bot phone number
- `recipients` (String) Recipient phone numbers (comma-separated)
- `url` (String, Sensitive) Signal API URL

### Optional

- `apply_existing` (Boolean) Attach this notification to all existing monitors. This is a one-time action: it runs when the notification is created with `true`, or when the value changes from `false` to `true`. Other updates do not attach it again, so monitors detached from the notification later stay detached. Uptime Kuma does not store the value, so the provider keeps it from the configuration. An imported notification starts with `false`.
- `is_default` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
